# Jude

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Jude is a passionate call to defend the truth of the gospel against false teaching and spiritual compromise. The book teaches that believers must remain faithful to sound doctrine, grow in spiritual maturity, show mercy to others, and trust God's power to preserve them until the end.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Jude 1:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Earnestly contend for the faith</div>

### Why This Verse

Defining exhortation of Jude

### Chapter Insight

This chapter urges believers to contend for the faith, warns against false teachers, and encourages perseverance in God's love. The key verse emphasizes defending the truth while trusting God's power to preserve His people.
:::
